name: Michael
bio: Michael, called "one of the chief princes" and the guardian prince of Israel, came to help Daniel when a vision of future conflict was delayed by a spiritual struggle against the princes of Persia and Greece; Daniel was told that at the time of the end, Michael would stand up for his people during an unprecedented time of trouble, and the righteous would be delivered (Daniel 10:13-21, 12:1). Centuries later, Jude cited an account of Michael disputing with the devil over the body of Moses, in which Michael did not presume to bring a slanderous accusation against him but simply said, "The Lord rebuke thee," an example of restraint even toward a powerful evil spirit (Jude 1:9).
